name: Jamaica
famous_for: Birthplace of Reggae music (Bob Marley), Blue Mountain specialty coffee, fiery Jerk chicken, and Seven Mile Beach in Negril.
tourists: Over 4.1M tourists annually; famous for Dunn's River Falls, Bob Marley Museum, and Doctor's Cave Beach.
must_know: 'One Love' and 'No Problem, Mon' encapsulate the relaxed, welcoming, and deeply resilient Rastafarian-influenced spirit.
fun_fact: Jamaica was the first Caribbean nation to produce commercial rum and continues to make world-renowned pot-still rums.
